payload.summary: MAR-2792 removes collection work observers from the production runtime; bounded-work evidence belongs at algorithm phases or external test seams.
decisions: Use native arrays, maps and sets. Do not reintroduce work-observer, operation labels, per-entry callbacks or observer exception translation.

Keep invocation-local canonical scan and graph phase hooks plus narrowly timed filesystem/artifact fault injection. The before-record-lstat fault and afterArtifactValidation checkpoint preserve disappearance and stale-artifact retry coverage.

Count graph target reads through test-owned supersedes arrays passed to the existing internal assertRecordGraph seam; precompute fixture bytes before wrapping. Exactly 1000 admitted edges require three linear walks; 1001 edges fail before any target reads.
Observe real baseline directory opens and injected bounded readers. Existing cache and gather phase, query and response-budget checks remain complementary.

Measure temporary payload-value retention inside the late descriptor trap, before rejection releases the buffer, using fresh unshared descriptor values and a values-only unbounded control. Post-rejection heap alone misses discarded excess allocation.
The packed-package check rejects observer modules, symbols and exact quoted collection-operation labels in JavaScript and declarations.
payload.verification: Targeted tests pass. Temporary extra graph traversal, repeated baseline directory enumeration, duplicated strict cache validation and uncapped payload-value retention each fail their behavioural guard; restored controls pass. Full CI and performance evidence must be checked on the reviewed head.
